name: Tokitama Phantasm
original_name: ときたまふぁんたずむ
source:
Heisuke is an ordinary high school student. However, he has a special ability that he can see spirits and remove spirits. He enjoys playing baseball on the last day of summer holiday and accidentally a ball he hit strikes on a head of a girl, who is a spirit? This is just the dawn of his strange life....
